description: This file contains functions and types for preparing and managing MCP (Message Control Protocol) configurations, including reading external configs, injecting config args, and creating temporary config files for CLI runs.

methods.name: readExternalMcpConfig
methods.description: Reads and parses an external MCP configuration file, returning a BundleMcpConfig object.

methods.name: findMcpConfigPath
methods.description: Searches command-line arguments for MCP config path flags and returns the path if found.

methods.name: injectMcpConfigArgs
methods.description: Injects MCP config path arguments into an existing argument list, replacing or appending as needed.

methods.name: prepareCliBundleMcpConfig
methods.description: Prepares a complete MCP configuration for CLI execution, including reading existing configs, merging, and creating temp files.
